items.title: Can CRM Stock Compound Its Way Higher?
items.summary: At $190.99, Salesforce (CRM) looks set up for roughly 24% of upside over the next three years under a conservative scenario. Not a big number, and most of what the business is doing is already in the price. The question is whether even this modest move is defensible. Revenue compounding does all the work; the multiple is asked to do nothing. Here is the operational reality the math is built on.
